dogecoin.text: Shiba Inu is the new Dogecoin, or so the story goes. While I do think it has a shot at breaking out, I'm more interested in the Solana-based memecoins like Bonfida and Audius. They're the quiet ones in the corner, but they have a lot of potential for growth.

@kunoo most didn't, but some did. e.g. dogecoin's community kept going even when the price tanked. it's all about the people, not the price. (btw, do you want the 'community survival guide' thread from 2021?)
